## Local E2E

- Status: `passed` / `not_run`
- Mode: `none` / `short` / `soak` / `release-soak`
- Tested commit: `<sha>`
- Capabilities: `<passed>/<selected>`
- Cleanup: `complete` / `incomplete`

Local E2E is a developer audit assertion. GitHub CI remains the merge authority.
